mapper.select: SELECT c.company_id AS salesCompanyId, c.company_abbreviation AS companyAbbreviation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) AS projectCount FROM basic_v2_company_management c LEFT JOIN basic_v2_department_management d ON c.company_id = d.company_id LEFT JOIN basic_v2_project_manage p ON d.department_id = p.department_id AND p.sales_company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.sale_or_procurement = 1 AND p.project_start_date <= #{startDate} AND ( (p.project_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NULL) ) GROUP BY c.company_id LIMIT #{start}, #{length}

SELECT d.department_id AS departmentId, d.department_abbreviation AS departmentAbbreviation, d.principal_name AS principalName, d.company_id AS companyId, COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) AS departmentProjectCount FROM basic_v2_department_management d LEFT JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON d.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN basic_v2_project_manage p ON d.department_id = p.department_id AND p.sales_company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.sale_or_procurement = 1 AND p.project_start_date <= #{startDate} AND ( (p.project_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NULL) ) GROUP BY d.department_id

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, p.project_name_abbreviation AS projectNameAbbreviation, COUNT(DISTINCT pd.staff_id) AS staffCount, p.department_id AS departmentId, p.sales_company_id AS companyId, p.project_start_date AS projectStartDate, p.project_scheduled_end_date AS projectScheduledEndDate, p.project_end_date AS projectEndDate, p.comment AS projectComment FROM basic_v2_project_manage p LEFT JOIN basic_v2_project_detail pd ON p.project_id = pd.project_id LEFT JOIN basic_v2_company_management c ON p.sales_company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.sale_or_procurement = 1 AND p.project_start_date <= #{startDate} AND ( (p.project_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NULL) ) GROUP BY p.project_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.company_id) FROM basic_v2_company_management c LEFT JOIN basic_v2_department_management d ON c.company_id = d.company_id LEFT JOIN basic_v2_project_manage p ON d.department_id = p.department_id AND p.sales_company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.sale_or_procurement = 1 AND p.project_start_date <= #{startDate} AND ( (p.project_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NOT NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-01')) OR (p.project_end_date IS NULL AND p.project_scheduled_end_date IS NULL) )

SELECT -- 获取销售公司简称 (SELECT company_abbreviation FROM basic_v2_company_management WHERE company_id = #{salesCompanyId} AND sale_or_procurement = '1' ) AS salesCompanyAbbreviation, -- 获取部门简称与责任人 (SELECT department_abbreviation FROM basic_v2_department_management WHERE department_id = #{departmentId}) AS departmentAbbreviation, -- 获取部门负责人姓名 (SELECT principal_name FROM basic_v2_department_management WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ) AS principalName, -- 获取项目基本信息 (SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'projectId', p.project_id, 'projectName', p.project_name, 'projectNameAbbreviation', p.project_name_abbreviation, 'departmentId', p.department_id, 'salesCompanyId', p.sales_company_id, 'projectStartDate', p.project_start_date, 'projectScheduledEndDate', p.project_scheduled_end_date, 'projectEndDate', p.project_end_date, 'siteAddress', p.site_address, 'startTime',DATE_FORMAT(p.start_time, '%H:%i'), 'endTime', DATE_FORMAT(p.end_time, '%H:%i'), 'dailyOperatingHours', p.daily_operating_hours, 'settlementUpperLimit', p.settlement_upper_limit, 'settlementLowerLimit', p.settlement_lower_limit, 'comment', p.comment ) FROM basic_v2_project_manage p WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} ) AS projectInfo,
-- 获取项目详细信息（附加公司简称和员工名称） ( SELECT IFNULL(JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'companyId', IFNULL(pd.company_id, 0), 'companyName', IFNULL(( SELECT company_abbreviation FROM basic_v2_company_management cm WHERE cm.company_id = pd.company_id ), ''), 'staffId', IFNULL(pd.staff_id, 0), 'staffName', IFNULL(( SELECT staff_name_kanji FROM basic_v2_company_staff cs WHERE cs.staff_id = pd.staff_id ), ''), 'entryDate', IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(pd.entry_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), null), 'plannedExitDate', IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(pd.planned_exit_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), null), 'actualExitDate', IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(pd.actual_exit_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), null), 'salesAmount', IFNULL(pd.sales_amount, 0), 'salesIncrementUnitPriceHour', IFNULL(pd.sales_increment_unit_price_hour, 0), 'salesDecrementUnitPriceHour', IFNULL(pd.sales_decrement_unit_price_hour, 0), 'amountRaised', IFNULL(pd.amount_raised, 0), 'procurementIncrementUnitPriceHour', IFNULL(pd.procurement_increment_unit_price_hour, 0), 'procurementDecrementUnitPriceHour', IFNULL(pd.procurement_decrement_unit_price_hour, 0), 'upperLimit', IFNULL(pd.upper_limit, 0), 'lowerLimit', IFNULL(pd.lower_limit, 0), 'comment', IFNULL(pd.comment, '') ) ), JSON_ARRAY()) FROM basic_v2_project_detail pd WHERE pd.project_id = #{projectId} AND pd.active_flg = 1 ) AS projectDetails, -- 获取劳动公司及其员工 (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'companyId', cm.company_id, 'companyName', cm.company_name, 'companyAbbreviation', cm.company_abbreviation, 'staff', staffList.staff_json ) ) FROM basic_v2_company_management cm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cs.company_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'staffId', cs.staff_id, 'staffName', cs.staff_name_kanji, 'noActiveProjects', ( CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM basic_v2_project_detail pd WHERE pd.staff_id = cs.staff_id ) THEN 'FALSE' ELSE 'TRUE' END ) ) ) AS staff_json FROM basic_v2_company_staff cs WHERE cs.active_flg = 1 GROUP BY cs.company_id ) AS staffList ON cm.company_id = staffList.company_id WHERE cm.sale_or_procurement IN ('2', '3') AND cm.active_flg = 1 ) AS laborCompaniesWithStaff;

SELECT -- 获取所有销售公司及其部门信息（JSON 格式） (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'companyId', c.company_id, 'companyAbbreviation', c.company_abbreviation, 'departments', ( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'departmentId', d.department_id, 'departmentAbbreviation', d.department_abbreviation, 'principalName', d.principal_name ) ) FROM basic_v2_department_management d WHERE d.company_id = c.company_id AND d.active_flg = 1 ) ) ) FROM basic_v2_company_management c WHERE c.sale_or_procurement = '1'AND active_flg = 1) AS salesCompaniesWithDepartments, -- 空的项目基本信息 (SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'projectId', NULL, 'projectName', NULL, 'projectNameAbbreviation', NULL, 'departmentId', NULL, 'salesCompanyId', NULL, 'projectStartDate', NULL, 'projectScheduledEndDate', NULL, 'projectEndDate', NULL, 'siteAddress', NULL, 'startTime', NULL, 'endTime', NULL, 'dailyOperatingHours', NULL, 'settlementUpperLimit', NULL, 'settlementLowerLimit', NULL, 'comment', NULL )) AS projectInfo, -- 空的项目详细信息（JSON 数组） (SELECT JSON_ARRAY()) AS projectDetails,
-- 获取劳动公司及其员工 (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'companyId', cm.company_id, 'companyName', cm.company_name, 'companyAbbreviation', cm.company_abbreviation, 'staff', staffList.staff_json ) ) FROM basic_v2_company_management cm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cs.company_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'staffId', cs.staff_id, 'staffName', cs.staff_name_kanji, 'noActiveProjects', ( CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM basic_v2_project_detail pd WHERE pd.staff_id = cs.staff_id AND pd.active_flg = 1 ) THEN 'FALSE' ELSE 'TRUE' END ) ) ) AS staff_json FROM basic_v2_company_staff cs WHERE cs.active_flg = 1 GROUP BY cs.company_id ) AS staffList ON cm.company_id = staffList.company_id WHERE cm.sale_or_procurement IN ('2', '3') AND cm.active_flg = 1 ) AS laborCompaniesWithStaff;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_v2_project_manage ( sales_company_id, department_id, project_name, project_name_abbreviation, project_start_date, project_scheduled_end_date, project_end_date, site_address, start_time, end_time, daily_operating_hours, settlement_upper_limit, settlement_lower_limit ) VALUES ( #{salesCompanyId}, #{departmentId}, #{projectName}, #{projectNameAbbreviation}, #{projectStartDate}, #{projectScheduledEndDate}, #{projectEndDate}, #{siteAddress}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{dailyOperatingHours}, #{settlementUpperLimit}, #{settlementLowerLimit} )

INSERT INTO basic_v2_project_detail ( project_id, staff_id, company_id, entry_date, planned_exit_date, actual_exit_date, sales_amount, sales_increment_unit_price_hour, sales_decrement_unit_price_hour, amount_raised, procurement_increment_unit_price_hour, procurement_decrement_unit_price_hour, upper_limit, lower_limit, comment ) VALUES
( #{projectId}, #{detail.staffId}, #{detail.companyId}, #{detail.entryDate}, #{detail.plannedExitDate}, #{detail.actualExitDate}, #{detail.salesAmount}, #{detail.salesIncrementUnitPriceHour}, #{detail.salesDecrementUnitPriceHour}, #{detail.amountRaised}, #{detail.procurementIncrementUnitPriceHour}, #{detail.procurementDecrementUnitPriceHour}, #{detail.upperLimit}, #{detail.lowerLimit}, #{detail.comment} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE basic_v2_project_detail
entry_date = #{entryDate}, planned_exit_date = #{plannedExitDate}, actual_exit_date = #{actualExitDate}, sales_amount = #{salesAmount}, sales_increment_unit_price_hour = #{salesIncrementUnitPriceHour},
sales_decrement_unit_price_hour = #{salesDecrementUnitPriceHour},
amount_raised = #{amountRaised}, procurement_increment_unit_price_hour = #{procurementIncrementUnitPriceHour},
procurement_decrement_unit_price_hour = #{procurementDecrementUnitPriceHour},
upper_limit = #{upperLimit},
lower_limit = #{lowerLimit},
comment = #{comment}
WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND staff_id = #{staffId}

UPDATE basic_v2_project_manage SET project_name = #{projectName}, project_name_abbreviation = #{projectNameAbbreviation}, project_start_date = #{projectStartDate}, project_scheduled_end_date = #{projectScheduledEndDate}, project_end_date = #{projectEndDate}, site_address = #{siteAddress}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, daily_operating_hours = #{dailyOperatingHours}, settlement_upper_limit = #{settlementUpperLimit}, settlement_lower_limit = #{settlementLowerLimit}, comment = #{comment} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
